title: Domestic joy without another binding duty

captions.energy: Starting without named conditions for continuation
captions.emotions: Enjoying clear results of shared care

meaning: Your domestic support brings more warmth when joy in a trial does not make its consequences permanent maintenance and both retain choice over further participation.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Fool in energy complicates them through an unprepared new beginning. The Sun in emotions wants to enjoy a clear result. Something pleasant can quickly become compulsory. Both easily add a possibility, then preserve it regardless of present usefulness. Pleasure in the first trial supposedly needs confirmation through further storage and care although shared experience retains value without permanent material continuation.

For example, you spontaneously buy equipment for homemade waffles. The first evening succeeds, but the device is later rarely used while space is cleared and accessories maintained. **Joy in an experience does not oblige its form to be sustained forever.** You can recognise the good and assess present use. Choice returns to both instead of pleasure proving authenticity through another duty merely because a beginning once felt easy, visible and genuinely pleasant to each.

The difficulty is considering review a devaluation of something good together. The object stays while freedom diminishes. Distinguishing experience from permanence offers more dependable support: one successful evening already has value. Home supports both through enjoying completed work without indefinitely preserving every material detail or turning a new possibility into an untouchable part of the entire future routine. Further participation can still be chosen rather than owed.
